newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - American Standard jumps.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - American Standard jumps.

text.p: American Standard Cos Inc shares rose to 45 from 40-1/4 head of Monday's market open on news the company received last month a takeover bid from Tyco International Ltd worth $50 a share in stock and cash.
The Wall Street Journal reported today that Tyco made the offer, worth $4 billion plus assumption of debt, in a letter dated December 5, 1996.
Tyco shares made no moves before the open, traders said.
The early move placed American Standard stock well above its year-high 41.

SysteMix Inc shares are poised to trade significantly higher at the start of the regular session after Novartis AG said it agreed to acquire the roughly 27 percent of the company it does not already own for $19.50 per share.
Before the market open, SysteMix shares were quoted at 19-3/8 bid, 19-3/4 ask, above the 15-5/16 Nasdaq close Friday.

Zurich Reinsurance Centre Holdings Inc shares were bid at 36, 5-1/4 above Friday's NYSE close on news Zurich Insurance Co has proposed acquisition of the one-third of Zurich Reinsurance is does not already own for $36 per share.
